request.label: outlet-b1c-admission
command:
import json,sys
from pathlib import Path
from resources import atomic,identity
from task2r_run import balance,memory_snapshot,memory_headroom
from task2_outlet_case import accepted_directory
root=Path(sys.argv[1]); evidence=root/"evidence"
ops=root/"operations"
live=balance(json.loads((root/"accounting.json").read_text()))
checks={name:json.loads((evidence/f"outlet-{name}-audit.json").read_text()) for name in ("B0","B1","A1c")}
screen=evidence/"outlet-matrix.json"
assert not json.loads(screen.read_text())["comparisons"]["B1-B0"]["failures"]
assert all(v=="MET" for name in ("B0","B1") for v in checks[name]["status"].values())
time_caps={"setup_and_possible_continuation_setup":104, "steady_and_continuation":2714,
           "assembly_compare_and_station_witness":666, "checkpoint3_publication":137,
           "final_publication_hold":300}
required=sum(time_caps.values())
assert min(live["nonprotected_remaining"],live["tranche_remaining"])>=required,(live,required)
mem=memory_snapshot()
assert memory_headroom(mem)>=12*1024**3,mem
anchors={}
for n in ("B0","B1","A1c"):
 case=accepted_directory(root,n)
 receipt=ops/(case.name+"-steady")/"receipt.json"
 data=json.loads(receipt.read_text())
 anchors[n]=dict(receipt=identity(receipt),elapsed=data["result"]["seconds"],peak_rss=data["result"]["peak_tree_rss_bytes"])
result=dict(schema="WJH27B1cAdmissionV1",status="ADMITTED",policy="ZeroTransverseV1",
 live_excluding_admission_reservation=live,required_seconds=required,
 no_new_allocation_needed=True, complete_cap_breakdown=time_caps,original_cost_anchors_seconds=[490,770,2301],
 accepted_anchors=anchors,screen=identity(screen),same_M1c_geometry=checks["A1c"]["provenance"]["mesh"],
 host_memory=mem,limit_bytes=10*1024**3)
atomic(Path(sys.argv[2]),result)
print(required,live,memory_headroom(mem))
